name: palworld-oneclick-panel
description: Cross-architecture Palworld server deployment and management panel.

scripts.check: node --check src/server.js && node --check src/upstream-compat.js && node --check src/advanced-features.js && node --check src/palworld-settings.js
scripts.build:pal-conf: npm --prefix vendor/pal-conf ci && npm --prefix vendor/pal-conf run build && node scripts/sync-pal-conf-build.js
scripts.build:web: npm run build:pal-conf && pnpm --dir upstream-web build
